about.description: From aviation lubricants and hydraulic fluids to specialist MRO products, AeroFlux connects operators, MROs and aviation businesses with trusted products and dependable global supply.
about.title: About Us
about.supplyBody: From aviation lubricants and hydraulic fluids to specialist MRO products, AeroFlux connects operators, MROs and aviation businesses with trusted products and dependable global supply.
driven: Founded in Dubai, AeroFlux Global was established to solve a simple but critical challenge - making aviation consumables more accessible, reliable and traceable for operators.
With deep industry knowledge and a global network of trusted manufacturers, we provide tailored procurement solutions for AOG and scheduled maintenance requirements.

At AeroFlux Global, we combine technical expertise, responsive service, and dependable global sourcing to simplify the procurement process. From specification verification and product sourcing to certification and delivery, every requirement is handled with precision—helping our customers reduce downtime, maintain compliance, and keep their operations moving forward.
